NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author has pushed 12 times since the label was added and now has two commits, with the Gitea test file added. The label came with no written feedback, and the new comment only asks for review.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Description, testing notes, before/after screenshots and self-review checklist are filled in, and CI passes |
| ❌  | The second commit ("fix test for PR comment") repairs a test the first commit broke, so it should be squashed into the first commit |
| ⚠️  | Open PR #40096 by the same author also touches Gogs PR topic titles, and the PR doesn't say how the two relate or whether one should replace the other |
| ℹ️  | No issue is linked ("Fixes:" has text but no #N), so there is no "help wanted" check to make |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to squash the test fix and explain how this PR relates to #40096. Once that's done, switch to "integration review" and assign laurynmm or Niloth P.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates! Could you squash the "fix test for PR comment" commit into the first commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)? Please also say how this PR relates to #40096, and whether the two should be combined.
```
